{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
data = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv')

# Deduplicate: keep the row with highest sample_seq per patient
data_dedup = data.loc[data.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].idxmax()]

# Verify: 800 rows after deduplication
print(f"Number of rows after deduplication: {len(data_dedup)}")
print(f"Number of unique patient_id: {data_dedup['patient_id'].nunique()}")

# Check that no duplicates remain
print(f"Any duplicate patient_id after dedup: {data_dedup['patient_id'].duplicated().any()}")"}
